message.content: The scalability limit is that sending every frame to a vision model is arithmetically impossible due to the free model tier's request limit [describe_architecture]. The system is designed to ration model calls, with a goal of reducing the number of frames that reach the model [describe_architecture]. The actual limit is that a busier site spends more, and a site busy enough that most frames are novel would exhaust the budget [describe_architecture].
